% Define rules

% Transitive closure of includes: a role includes another if directly or transitively
includes(Role, IncludedRole) :- includes_direct(Role, IncludedRole).
includes(Role, IncludedRole) :- includes_direct(Role, X), includes(X, IncludedRole).

% Get all roles for a user (through group membership and grants)
user_role(User, Role) :- member(User, Group), grant(Group, Role).

% Get all roles for a user including transitively included roles
user_has_role(User, Role) :- user_role(User, Role).
user_has_role(User, IncludedRole) :- user_has_role(User, Role), includes(Role, IncludedRole).

% Get all resources accessible by a user through their roles
user_resource_raw(User, Resource) :- user_has_role(User, Role), permit(Role, Resource, _).

% Apply revocations: a user can access a resource if they have access through roles AND it's not revoked
user_resource(User, Resource) :- user_resource_raw(User, Resource), \+ revoked(User, Resource).
